title: MCPG plugin descriptor — schema v1
description: JSON Schema for `plugin.yaml` files conforming to `mcpg.dev/plugin/v1`. Matches the `PluginDescriptor` struct in `libs/plugin-protocol/src/descriptor.rs`. Normative; the gateway rejects descriptors that fail validation. See https://mcpg.dev/docs/plugins/plugins-and-protocol for the semantic contract each field carries.

schema.description: Schema identifier. MUST be the literal `mcpg.dev/plugin/v1`. Future schemas bump this field before any other breaking change.

id.description: Reverse-DNS plugin identifier, MUST be globally unique. MUST equal the in-code `PluginManifest.id`. Lowercase; dot-separated; each segment is `[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]*`; at least two segments. Case-sensitive. Convention: `dev.mcpg.<short>` for first-party, `<vendor-tld>.<vendor>.<name>` for third-party.

name.description: Human-readable display name. Shown in admin surfaces.

license.description: SPDX license identifier of the plugin's source license (e.g. `Apache-2.0`). Informational — surfaced to catalogs / marketplaces and admin inventory; the gateway does not act on it.

description.description: Free-form long description. Shown in admin surfaces and plugin catalogues.

runtime.description: Runtime class. Determines how the gateway loads the plugin. `static-firstparty-v1` is reserved for foundational plugins (the testing tier + gateway built-ins); external plugins MUST declare `native-cdylib-v1` or `wasi-v1`.

protocol_version.description: Plugin protocol version this plugin targets, as a semver string. Currently `1.0`. The host loads a plugin only if the declared version falls within its supported range.

required_capabilities.description: Typed host capabilities the plugin needs. Each entry is either a bare string for no-args variants (e.g. "network_outbound") or an object with `type` + variant args (e.g. {type: "filesystem_read", paths: ["/etc/myapp"]}). The gateway refuses to start if any required capability is not covered by the operator's `plugins[].granted_capabilities` grant set.

tags.description: Free-form classification tags. Plugin authors declare labels like `enterprise`, `paid`, `experimental`, `security-critical`, `vendor:hashicorp`. Operators wire these into a `policy_engine` chain at the `plugin.lifecycle.register` decision point so the engine can deny / allow plugin loading per their org's rules. No well-known enum — operators define their own scheme.

provides.description: Cluster slot roles this plugin provides. Used by `cluster` plugins to declare which gateway slots they can back — one or more of `cache` / `kv` / `bus`. Empty / absent for non-cluster plugin classes. The gateway cross-checks this list against the runtime `ClusterBackend::cluster_provides()` and the wiring fallback table at boot and fails-closed on drift. (Slot-role vocabulary, distinct from the trait's primitive accessor methods key_value_store / pub_sub / lease / watch.)

provides_schemes.description: URI schemes this plugin claims for auto-routing (Layout D'' P8). Required for `secret_provider` and `config_provider` plugin classes — those classes route by URI scheme prefix only. Conflicts (two plugins claiming the same scheme) refuse boot. Built-in `env` and `file` schemes are reserved.
